author: Stahly
description:
When official Exodite models were finally announced after decades of waiting, I was instantly hyped as an old-school pointy-ear fan. The moment I got my hands on Kill Team: Exodite, I built a Clanblade and got straight to work. It took a while, but the model is finally finished. In this post, I'll show you all the details and walk you through my approach.

The post Two months, one drakesteed: painting Kill Team’s new Exodite Clanblade appeared first on Tale of Painters.
title: Two months, one drakesteed: painting Kill Team’s new Exodite Clanblade
